# Packages laden

```{r}
library(knitr)
library(limma)
library(minfi)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kmanifest)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(missMethyl)
library(minfiData)
library(Gviz)

library(stringr)
```

```{r}
# get the 450k annotation data
ann450k <- getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
head(ann450k)
```
# BRCA-Methylioerungsdaten in eine Matrix umwandeln
## Methylierungsdaten laden
```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirnmae(wd), '/data/BRCA_methylation_data.csv')
BRCA_methylation_data_original <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

# Umwandeln
```{r}
BRCA_methylation_matrix <- as.matrix(BRCA_methylation_data_original)
```

# Density Plot probieren
```{r}
densityPlot(BRCA_methylation_matrix[10,],
            main = "Beta Values",
            legend = FALSE,
            xlab = "Beta values")
```
# Design Matrix erstellen
```{r}
wd <- getwd()
data_path <- paste0(dirname(wd), '/data/BRCA_sample_sheet.csv')
BRCA_sample_sheet <- read.csv(data_path, row.names=1)
```

```{r}
#Syntax konform machen
BRCA_sample_sheet$Type[1:30] <- c(rep("Primary.solid.Tumor",30))
BRCA_sample_sheet$Type[31:60] <- c(rep("Solid.Tissue.Normal",30))

# der Faktor, der uns interssiert, namlich Tumor und Normal
tissueType <- factor(BRCA_sample_sheet$Type)

# erstellen einer design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~0+tissueType)
colnames(design) <- levels(tissueType)
write.csv(design, file="DMA_model_matrix.csv")
# lineares models fitten
fit <- lmFit(BRCA_methylation_data_original, design)

print(fit)
```

```{r}
# erstellen einer Kontrastmatrix für soezifischen Vergleich
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(Primary.solid.Tumor-Solid.Tissue.Normal, levels=design)
write.csv(contrast_matrix, file = "DMA_contrast_matrix.csv")
# Kontraste anwenden
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# Ergebnisse anzeigen
results <- topTable(fit2, adjust="fdr", sort.by="P")
head(results)

#Anzahl an DM CpGs bei einer FDR<0.05
summary(decideTests(fit2))
```

```{r}
# Reihenfolge der CpGs in der Annotationstabelle an die Ergebnisse anpassen
ann450kSub <- ann450k[match(rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original), ann450k$Name), ]

# Ergebnisse mit Annotationstabelle verknüpfen
DMPs <- topTable(fit2, num=Inf, coef=1, genelist=ann450kSub)
head(DMPs)
write.csv(DMPs,file="DMPs.csv")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
sapply(rownames(DMPs)[1:4], function(cpg){
  plotCpg(BRCA_methylation_data_original, cpg=cpg, pheno=BRCA_sample_sheet$Type, ylab = "Beta values")
})
```

## Visualisierung der Ergebnisse mit ggplot

```{r}
# notwendige libraries laden
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r}
# CpG-Stellen nach Signifikanz sortieren
sorted_CpGs <- DMPs %>%
  arrange(P.Value) %>%
  pull(Name)
```

```{r}
create_long_data <- function(cpg){
# Beispielhafte CpG-Stelle auswählen
selected_cpg <- cpg

# Daten in langes Format umwandeln
long_data <- BRCA_methylation_data_original %>%
  filter(rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original) == selected_cpg) %>% # Wähle die Zeile für die ausgewählte CpG-Stelle aus
  pivot_longer(cols = c(colnames(BRCA_methylation_data_original)), names_to = "Patient", values_to = "BetaValue") %>% # Verwandle Spalten in Zeilen
  mutate(Group = case_when(
    row_number() <= 30 ~ "Primary solid Tumor", # Weise den ersten 30 Einträgen "Tumor" zu
    row_number() > n() - 30 ~ "Solid Tissue Normal" # Weise den letzten 30 Einträgen "Healthy" zu
  ))%>%
  mutate(CpG = selected_cpg) # einfügen einer spalte CpG
return(long_data)
}
# Daten für die ersten 6 CpGs erstellen und zusammenführen
plot_data <- bind_rows(lapply(sorted_CpGs[1:6], create_long_data))
# Sortiere plot_data basierend auf den sortierten CpG-Stellen
plot_data$CpG <- factor(plot_data$CpG, levels = sorted_CpGs)

# Kombinierten Plot erstellen
combined_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=CpG, y = BetaValue, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.25, position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  labs(x= "CpG sites",y = "beta value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.margin = margin(25, 25, 25, 25)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ CpG,ncol=6, scales = "free_x")+
scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub(" .*", "", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.3, 0.3)))

print(combined_plot)

# Plot speichern
ggsave(filename = "DMA_limma_boxplots_6_sig_CpGs.pdf", plot = combined_plot, width = 20, height = 8)

```
